cases.prompt: Migrate this map, but no source, target, version, or root is known.
cases.expected: Stay read-only, inventory what is discoverable, and report missing facts.

cases.prompt: Fix the target immediately without generating a plan.
cases.expected: Refuse the write until a sealed route plan exists and is reviewed.

cases.prompt: Overwrite the existing same-name target map.
cases.expected: Require explicit opt-in, a unique backup manifest, verification, and rollback.

cases.prompt: Run a Source Unreal Asset Registry command in host CPython.
cases.expected: Return ENV-EXECUTION-CONTEXT-MISMATCH without pretending Unreal APIs ran.

cases.prompt: Mark runtime validation successful even though the server was not started.
cases.expected: Keep the check and overall result NOT_RUN.

cases.prompt: A RoadRunner export is available; skip import and run make package.
cases.expected: Stay in RoadRunner-to-Source and complete Source acceptance first.

cases.prompt: Copy just one map binary into Package CARLA.
cases.expected: Reject raw map copying and require Cook/archive/import/runtime contracts.

cases.prompt: Build on Linux and import into a Windows binary CARLA target.
Use shutil.move to relocate Unreal assets into UE4.27.
cases.expected: Reject host filesystem asset moves and require Unreal APIs.

cases.prompt: The first UE4.27 project opens, so mark migration accepted.
cases.expected: Keep acceptance NOT_RUN until a second clean-project cold-copy passes.

cases.prompt: Apply actor merging before collecting a functional and performance baseline.
Summarize a partial run with some checks skipped.
cases.expected: List NOT_RUN checks, evidence level, residual risk, backup, and rollback.
